name: Kawamura Fumika
source:
[url=/c1066]Akito's[/url] classmate. She has a neat and short-cut hair. She acts coldly towards everyone. Even though she looks cool all the times, she won't act like that to the extent of degree sometimes. Fumika joins in the Table Tennis Club as a regular member.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=66661]Getchu's website[/url].]
